EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Subject: Your Wadhwani Grants password was changed
Hello {{{contact_first_name}}},
This is a confirmation that the password for your Wadhwani Grants account was changed on {{{change_date}}}.
If this was you, no action is needed.
If this wasn’t you, secure your account immediately by resetting your password here: {{{reset_link}}}
Anything unusual? Reply to this email and our team will investigate.
Warm regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
[grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
© {{{year}}} Wadhwani Grants.
